summary_en: Leases, rent, owners, tenants, maintenance and trust accounting.
summary_fr: Baux, quittances, propriétaires, locataires, travaux et comptabilité mandant.

tools.name: Aareon
tools.positioning: The European ERP of social and institutional housing — where the tenant file, the rent and the works order live together.
tools.description: Aareon provides enterprise property management software for social landlords, institutional owners and large managers across Europe, with a French organisation serving bailleurs sociaux: tenant and lease management, rent and charge accounting, allocation processes, maintenance and tenant self-service portals.
tools.real_estate_use: French social housing operates under rules no commercial system covers: regulated rents, the allocation commission, the surface and resource ceilings, the supplément de loyer. Aareon's French deployments encode those processes, which is why the sector runs on specialised ERPs rather than on general property management platforms.
features: Tenant, lease and allocation management for regulated housing
Rent and charge accounting with regulatory rules
Maintenance and works order management
Tenant self-service portal and digital services
Asset and patrimony management
Regulatory and management reporting

use_cases.job: Run regulated allocation and rent processes for a social housing portfolio
Hold asset, lease and works data for a large institutional patrimony in one ERP

tools.name: Apartments.com
tools.positioning: The dominant US rental marketplace, bundled with free tooling that pulls small landlords onto the platform.
tools.description: CoStar's rental network — Apartments.com and its sister sites — lists apartments and single-family rentals nationally. Alongside paid advertising for professional managers, it offers small landlords free listing, online applications, tenant screening, lease signing and rent collection.
tools.real_estate_use: A professional manager buys placement and lead volume for a lease-up. An individual landlord uses the free side as their entire operating system: list the unit, receive applications with credit and background checks, sign a state-specific lease and collect rent by ACH. That free tier is why so many small portfolios never buy dedicated property management software.
features: National rental listing network with paid placement tiers
Online rental applications with tenant screening
State-specific lease templates and e-signature
Online rent collection and payment tracking
Renter profiles and application reuse
Rental market rent comparables for pricing

use_cases.job: Fill vacancies in a lease-up with paid placement and measured lead volume
List, screen, lease and collect rent on a handful of units at no software cost

tools.name: AppFolio Property Manager
tools.positioning: The mid-market property management system that made cloud-native and mobile-first the default expectation.
tools.description: AppFolio is an all-in-one property management platform covering residential, commercial, student and community association portfolios: marketing and leasing, applicant screening, online payments, maintenance, full trust accounting and owner reporting, with AI features branded Realm.
tools.real_estate_use: A management company running a few thousand units uses it as the system of record for the whole operation. A vacancy is syndicated to the rental portals, an applicant is screened and signs a lease online, rent arrives by ACH, a maintenance request from the tenant app becomes a work order to a vendor, and the owner receives a statement generated from the same ledger. The differentiator in practice is that the accounting is genuinely built in, not bolted on.
features: Vacancy marketing with syndication to rental portals
Online applications, screening and lease e-signature
Online rent collection and utility billing
Maintenance work orders with vendor management and a 24/7 call answering option
Full trust accounting, owner statements and 1099 handling
Resident and owner portals with mobile apps

use_cases.job: Run leasing, rent, maintenance and owner accounting for thousands of units in one ledger
Receive an owner statement generated from the actual accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: Avail
tools.positioning: DIY landlord tooling with the distribution of a national portal behind it.
tools.description: Avail gives independent landlords listing syndication, online applications, credit and background screening, state-specific lease agreements, digital signatures, rent collection with credit reporting for tenants, and maintenance tracking. Owned by Realtor.com.
tools.real_estate_use: The distribution matters: a unit listed in Avail appears on Realtor.com and partner sites, so a landlord with two properties reaches the same audience as a management company. Rent payments can be reported to credit bureaus, which landlords use as an incentive for on-time payment.
features: Listing syndication through the Realtor.com network
Online applications with credit, criminal and eviction screening
State-specific lease agreements with digital signing
Rent collection with optional credit bureau reporting
Maintenance tracking and vendor coordination
Rent price analysis for a given address

Build credit history by having on-time rent reported to the bureaus

tools.name: Buildium
tools.positioning: The property management system a small management company can actually implement without a project team.
tools.description: Buildium covers residential rentals, community associations and affordable housing: listings, applications and screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance, accounting and owner reporting, with published per-unit pricing and self-serve onboarding. Now part of RealPage.
tools.real_estate_use: It sits at the tier below AppFolio and Entrata: a company managing a few hundred doors, often mixed between rentals and homeowner associations. The HOA module handles association dues, violations and architectural requests, which is why small managers with both books of business consolidate here rather than run two systems.
features: Listings, applications and tenant screening
Lease management with e-signature and renewals
Online rent and association dues collection
Maintenance requests, work orders and vendor payments
Property, owner and association accounting with 1099s
Resident, owner and board member portals

use_cases.job: Manage a few hundred rental doors without a dedicated systems administrator
Run homeowner association dues, violations and board reporting in the same tool as rentals

tools.name: Check & Visit
tools.positioning: Inspection software combined with a field network — the report can be produced by their operator rather than by your staff.
tools.description: Check & Visit provides digital état des lieux and property visit software for French professionals, together with a network of field operators who can carry out the inspection on the manager's behalf, and 3D capture options attached to the same record.
tools.real_estate_use: For a manager with dispersed properties, the constraint on inspections is travel time, not software. Outsourcing the visit to a local operator while keeping the report in the same digital format lets a lettings team scale without hiring inspectors — and the attached 3D capture doubles as a marketing asset for the next letting.
features: Digital état des lieux with photographic evidence
Field operator network performing inspections on request
3D capture and virtual visit attached to the property record
Electronic signature and report generation
Portfolio dashboard for inspection status
Integration with management software

Capture a 3D visit at the same appointment as the inspection

tools.name: Crypto (Septeo Solutions Immobilier)
tools.positioning: The incumbent French property administration suite — installed across a large share of professional syndic and gérance portfolios.
tools.description: Crypto, part of Septeo's real estate division, covers syndic, gérance and transaction for French property administrators: per-building and mandant accounting, calls for funds, assemblies, lease and receipt management, and extranets for co-owners, owners and tenants.
tools.real_estate_use: It is the system of record in many established French administration de biens firms, chosen for accounting depth rather than for interface. Its centre of gravity is the regulated ledger: separate accounts per copropriété, mandant funds kept distinct from the firm's own money, and the reporting a comptable and an auditor expect.

Gérance with mandant accounting and owner reddition de comptes
Calls for funds, budgets and assembly management
Lease, receipt and indexation handling
Co-owner, owner and tenant extranets
Transaction module and document management

Produce owner reddition de comptes from mandant accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: DoorLoop
tools.positioning: The recent challenger — the same feature checklist as the incumbents, with an interface people learn in an afternoon.
tools.description: DoorLoop is a cloud property management platform covering rentals, associations and commercial portfolios: listings and screening, leases and e-signature, rent collection, maintenance, accounting with QuickBooks sync, and tenant and owner portals. It competes on usability and published pricing.
tools.real_estate_use: Its typical buyer is a manager leaving spreadsheets, or one leaving an older system whose interface their staff never mastered. The practical argument is onboarding time: a small team can go live in days, and the accounting exports cleanly to QuickBooks, which the bookkeeper already uses.
features: Listings, applications and tenant screening
Lease templates with e-signature and automated renewals
Online rent collection with automatic late fees
Maintenance requests, vendor assignment and tracking

Tenant, owner and vendor portals

Collect rent, track maintenance and report to owners from one place

tools.name: EliseAI
tools.positioning: An AI leasing agent that answers, qualifies and books tours around the clock — measured on tours booked, not on messages sent.
tools.description: EliseAI provides conversational AI for multifamily and healthcare operators: it answers prospect enquiries by email, SMS, web chat and voice, qualifies against availability and criteria, schedules tours directly into the calendar, and follows up through the application and renewal stages.
tools.real_estate_use: Leasing enquiries arrive outside office hours and go cold within the hour. EliseAI answers immediately in the channel the prospect used, checks real availability against the property management system, and books the tour without a human. Operators measure it on tour conversion and on the leasing headcount it lets them redeploy.
features: Conversational responses across email, SMS, web chat and voice
Availability-aware qualification against the property management system
Automatic tour scheduling into leasing calendars
Application follow-up and document chasing
Renewal and delinquency outreach campaigns
Maintenance request intake and triage

Chase renewals and missing application documents automatically

tools.name: Entrata
tools.positioning: A single-stack multifamily operating system — the accounting ledger and the leasing website are the same product, not an integration.
tools.description: Entrata is a multifamily-focused platform combining property accounting, leasing and marketing websites, resident portals, utility billing, insurance, revenue management and an AI leasing agent. Its architectural claim is one database behind every module rather than a suite assembled by acquisition.
tools.real_estate_use: Large apartment operators use it to run a lease-up and a stabilised asset on the same ledger. A prospect finds the community site, is answered by the AI leasing agent at midnight, tours, applies and signs — and the rent, concessions and renewal pricing all post to the same accounting without a nightly file transfer between systems.

Marketing websites and ILS syndication per community
AI leasing agent handling prospect enquiries and tour scheduling
Resident portal with payments, renewals and service requests
Revenue management and pricing optimisation
Utility billing, insurance and ancillary revenue modules

Compare asset performance across a portfolio without reconciling systems

capabilities: AI leasing agent for enquiries and tours

tools.name: Gercop
tools.positioning: Property administration software for larger French firms, where volume and multi-site organisation are the constraint.
tools.description: Gercop, also part of Septeo, provides syndic, gérance and transaction management for French administration de biens: accounting, assemblies, calls for funds, lease management, extranets and business reporting, aimed at structures managing large portfolios.
tools.real_estate_use: At the scale of tens of thousands of lots across multiple branches, the operational problem moves from bookkeeping to organisation: who manages which building, which assemblies fall in which month, where arrears are concentrating. Gercop is bought for that management layer over the same regulated accounting base.

Assembly planning and convocation across many buildings
Calls for funds, arrears tracking and recovery workflows
Lease management with indexation and charge regularisation
Multi-branch organisation and portfolio assignment
Management reporting and dashboards

use_cases.job: Plan and run assemblies across hundreds of buildings without losing deadlines
Track arrears concentration across a large managed portfolio

tools.name: Gererseul
tools.positioning: Software for the landlord who has decided not to hire an agency — and needs the paperwork to be right anyway.
tools.description: Gererseul provides French private landlords with lease creation, rent call and receipt generation, payment and arrears tracking, charge regularisation, indexation, and document templates for the standard events of a tenancy.
tools.real_estate_use: Self-management fails on the events, not on the routine: the annual IRL indexation letter, the charge regularisation, the notice given in the correct form and delay. Gererseul's value is the template and the calendar around those moments, so a landlord does not discover a procedural defect at the tribunal.

Rent calls, receipts and payment tracking
IRL indexation calculation and notification letters
Charge regularisation from actual expenses
Arrears reminders and formal notice templates
Document library for tenancy events

Regularise charges against actual expenses at the end of the year

tools.name: Hemlane
tools.positioning: Software plus a local agent and a 24/7 repair desk — for the owner who is not in the same city as the property.
tools.description: Hemlane combines rental management software with optional human services: a local leasing agent network for showings, and 24/7 maintenance coordination that triages tenant calls and dispatches vendors. Owners choose how much of the operation to delegate.
tools.real_estate_use: It targets the remote owner who does not want a full management company taking eight to ten percent. The software handles marketing, screening and rent; the local agent handles the showing that cannot be done remotely; the repair desk answers the two a.m. burst pipe. The economics sit deliberately between self-management and full delegation.
features: Listing syndication and applicant screening
Local leasing agent network for showings
24/7 maintenance coordination and vendor dispatch
Rent collection with automated reminders
Lease tracking with state-specific compliance guidance
Owner reporting and financial exports

Have someone answer the emergency maintenance call at night

tools.name: ICS
tools.positioning: Independent French software suite for property administrators, used daily by more than 18,000 professionals across cloud-based syndic, management, rental and transaction modules.
tools.description: ICS is a French software suite built for administrateurs de biens, covering condominium syndic management, property management, rental management and sales transactions. It is delivered as cloud applications accessible from a standard web browser, with servers hosted in a Class IV datacenter.
tools.real_estate_use: Property management firms and syndics in France use ICS to run their daily back office: co-ownership accounting, fund calls and general assembly administration through the syndic module, rental portfolio tracking through the gestion and location modules, and sales file follow-up through the transaction module. Because it runs in the cloud, staff access the same accounting and extra-accounting environment from any browser without maintaining local servers or a VPN.
features: Cloud-based access to accounting and extra-accounting environment via web browser
Syndic module for condominium accounting and general assembly management
Gestion module for property management portfolios
Location module for rental management
Transaction module for sales transaction tracking
Hosting in a Class IV datacenter with audited backup strategy

use_cases.job: Manage condominium accounting, fund calls and general assemblies from a cloud application
Administer rental and managed property portfolios without on-premise IT infrastructure
Track sales transactions within the same software suite used for management and syndic activity

tools.name: Immofacile
tools.positioning: A French agency package sold module by module, so a small agency buys only the trade it practises.
tools.description: Immofacile provides French real estate professionals with transaction software, rental management and syndic modules, portal publishing, agency websites and document management, packaged so an agency subscribes only to the activities it holds.
tools.real_estate_use: Small French agencies rarely practise all three regulated activities, and paying for a full administration suite to run transaction alone is a common source of overspend. Modular pricing is the practical argument here, with the option to add gérance later without migrating the client and property records.
features: Modular transaction, rental and syndic activities
Mandate management and buyer matching
Portal publishing and agency website
Owner and tenant document management
Electronic signature integration
Accounting for the modules subscribed

use_cases.job: Subscribe only to the regulated activities the agency actually practises
Add rental management later without migrating existing records

tools.name: Immopad
tools.positioning: Digital property inspections on tablet — état des lieux, delivery snagging and periodic visits in one app.
tools.description: Immopad is a French application for property inspections: entry and exit état des lieux, new-build delivery snagging, periodic visits and works acceptance, captured on tablet or phone with photos, signed on the spot and produced as a report.
tools.real_estate_use: The état des lieux is the document a deposit dispute turns on, and a paper one written in ballpoint rarely survives it. Capturing room by room with dated photographs and an on-the-spot signature changes the evidentiary position entirely. The same capture engine is used by developers for delivery snagging, where the list of reserves has the same contentious quality.
features: Entry and exit état des lieux with photo evidence
Comparison between entry and exit condition
New-build delivery snagging and reserve tracking
On-site signature by both parties
Periodic and works acceptance visits
Report generation and archiving

use_cases.job: Produce an état des lieux that survives a deposit dispute
Record and track delivery reserves at handover of a new-build unit

tools.name: Innago
tools.positioning: Free landlord software aimed squarely at the small and student-rental owner.
tools.description: Innago provides rent collection, online leasing and e-signature, applications and screening, maintenance ticketing and basic accounting, free to the landlord with revenue coming from optional paid services and payment processing.
tools.real_estate_use: It is heavily used for student housing and small multifamily, where a single unit may have four tenants each paying a share of the rent. Splitting a lease across roommates, collecting partial payments and tracking who is short is the specific problem it handles more gracefully than most paid systems.
features: Rent collection with roommate payment splitting
Online applications and tenant screening
Lease creation with e-signature and templates
Maintenance ticketing with photo upload
Expense tracking and basic reporting
Tenant portal and automated reminders

use_cases.job: Collect rent from four roommates on one student lease without manual reconciliation
Run a small portfolio at no software cost

tools.name: LockImmo
tools.positioning: One French system for the three trades an agency can hold at once — transaction, gérance and syndic.
tools.description: LockImmo is a modular French real estate platform covering transaction, rental management and condominium management, with accounting, owner and co-owner portals, electronic signature and portal publishing, sold module by module.
tools.real_estate_use: A French agency frequently holds all three activities under one roof, and the accounting requirements differ for each: mandant accounting for gérance, separate accounts per copropriété for syndic. LockImmo covers the three in one system, which small and mid-sized agencies choose over running three specialised tools with no shared client record.
features: Transaction module with mandates and matching
Rental management with mandant accounting and owner statements
Condominium module with per-building accounting and calls for funds
Owner, tenant and co-owner extranet portals
Electronic signature and document management
Portal publishing and agency website

use_cases.job: Hold transaction, gérance and syndic in one system with shared client records
Run per-building accounting and calls for funds alongside rental management

tools.name: Matera
tools.positioning: Digital platform that lets condominium councils run their own cooperative syndic while a team of in-house experts handles the technical, legal and accounting complexity.
tools.description: Matera is a SaaS platform for French condominiums choosing the cooperative-syndic model, where the council of co-owners manages the building itself instead of hiring a professional syndic firm. The platform centralizes real-time accounting, budget tracking, service-charge calls, document storage, an online messaging system and general-assembly organization (including video conferencing and online voting), and gives access to Matera's in-house teams of accountants, lawyers and building-works specialists for complex matters. Matera also offers a separate rental-management product for landlords who self-manage tenanted properties.
tools.real_estate_use: A council of co-owners who wants to drop a traditional syndic firm and take direct control of the building's finances and decisions logs into Matera to track the budget, issue and follow up on service charges, and organize the annual general assembly online. When an incident occurs, such as a water leak, any council member can open a work order, contact a vetted local tradesperson from Matera's network, and follow the repair through to closure on the same platform. When a legal, accounting or technical question goes beyond what the council can resolve alone, they escalate it to Matera's in-house experts rather than hiring outside consultants.
features: Real-time per-building accounting dashboard
Automated service-charge calls and payment reminders
Online general-assembly organization with video conferencing and voting
Dedicated messaging space for council and co-owners
Document repository (minutes, contracts, invoices)
Work-order tracking for incidents and repairs

use_cases.job: Manage the condominium's budget, accounting and service-charge billing without a professional syndic firm
Organize and run the general assembly online, including votes and minutes distribution
Track incidents and repair work orders through resolution using a vetted tradesperson network

tools.name: Modelo
tools.positioning: French real estate legal drafting kept current with the law — mandates, leases and offers generated rather than copied from an old file.
tools.description: Modelo produces legal documents for French real estate professionals: mandates, purchase offers, compromis, leases and their annexes, generated from a clause library maintained against current legislation, with electronic signature and file management.
tools.real_estate_use: French real estate law changes often enough that the biggest documentary risk in an agency is the template someone saved in 2019. Modelo's proposition is that the clause library is maintained centrally: when a legal obligation changes, the generated document changes, and the agency does not have to notice.

Mandate, offer, compromis and lease generation
Annex assembly including mandatory disclosures
Electronic signature integration
Document file management per transaction
Updates tracking legislative change

Generate leases and annexes with the current mandatory disclosures attached

tools.name: MRI Software
tools.positioning: The open alternative to a single-vendor stack — bring your own best-of-breed and let MRI hold the lease and the ledger.
tools.description: MRI Software provides property and lease management, accounting, investment management, facilities and workplace products across commercial and residential real estate worldwide. Its stated strategy is an open platform: published APIs and a partner ecosystem rather than a closed suite.
tools.real_estate_use: A European or transatlantic owner often cannot standardise on one vendor — local accounting, local leasing practice and existing systems all resist it. MRI is chosen when the lease and financial core must be common while country teams keep their own tools around it. In France it supports local lease and accounting requirements alongside Anglo-Saxon reporting.

Real estate accounting with multi-entity and multi-currency
Investment management and investor reporting
Facilities management and workplace modules
Lease accounting compliance for IFRS 16 and ASC 842
Open APIs and a partner integration ecosystem

Meet IFRS 16 lease accounting obligations from the lease system itself

tools.name: Powimo
tools.positioning: Full-web property and condominium management software built to raise the productivity of property management firms.
tools.description: Powimo is a SaaS software for property administrators (ADB) covering both syndic (condominium) and rental management activities. It is organized into modules covering mandates, accounting, general assemblies, tenant/owner extranet, move-in/move-out inspections, maintenance requests, and letting.
tools.real_estate_use: A syndic manager uses Powimo to track co-ownership mandates, run accounting per building, prepare and hold dematerialized general assemblies, and issue fund calls to co-owners. Per-building accounting and account consultation
General assembly management (including dematerialized AGs)
Supplier compliance checks
Data hub with business indicators
Document dematerialization and automation

Handle rental management, letting and tenant applications
Consult accounting and documents through a dedicated client portal

tools.name: Property Meld
tools.positioning: Residential maintenance coordination as its own discipline — because it is where property managers lose their margin and their reputation.
tools.description: Property Meld handles the maintenance workflow for residential property management: tenant request intake with triage, vendor scheduling and coordination, communication across all parties, and analytics on speed and cost per repair.
tools.real_estate_use: In residential management, maintenance is the largest source of complaints and the biggest drain on staff time — mostly spent as phone tag between a tenant, a vendor and an owner trying to agree a time. Property Meld automates the scheduling coordination, and its metrics — median speed to resolution, cost per unit — are the ones managers now report to owners.

Automated vendor and tenant scheduling coordination
Owner approval workflows for repairs above a threshold
Vendor performance and cost analytics
Communication log across tenant, vendor and owner
Speed-to-resolution and cost-per-unit reporting

Approve repairs above a threshold with the evidence in front of you

tools.name: Propertyware
tools.positioning: Built for scattered single-family rentals, where every door is a different address with a different owner.
tools.description: Propertyware is a management platform specialised in single-family and small residential portfolios: owner and tenant portals, a flexible accounting engine, mobile inspections, a maintenance module, and an open API used to wire in external marketing and screening.
tools.real_estate_use: Managing 800 scattered houses is not managing an 800-unit building. Every property has its own owner with its own management agreement, its own maintenance reserve and its own reporting expectations. Propertyware's accounting is built around that fragmentation, and its inspection app exists because staff spend the day driving between assets.

Mobile property inspections with photos
Maintenance workflow with vendor assignment and billing
Owner and tenant portals with online payments

Track maintenance reserves and net owner distributions per property

tools.name: RealPage
tools.positioning: The broadest multifamily suite in the market — and the one whose revenue management product put algorithmic rent pricing under legal scrutiny.
tools.description: RealPage sells a wide portfolio for multifamily and single-family rental operators: property management systems (OneSite, Propertyware, Buildium), leasing and marketing, screening, utility management, asset optimisation and the AI Revenue Management products descended from YieldStar and LRO.

That last product is the subject of US antitrust litigation over algorithmic pricing, which is now part of any serious evaluation of it.

Applicant screening and fraud detection
Utility billing and expense recovery
Leasing, marketing and contact centre services
Asset and portfolio performance analytics

Benchmark asset performance against a national multifamily dataset

tools.name: Rentila
tools.positioning: Free rental management for the French private landlord — leases, receipts and the tax return line.
tools.description: Rentila is an online rental management service for individual landlords in France: lease generation, rent receipts, payment tracking, charge regularisation, tenant and property records, document storage and reporting, with a free tier and paid options.

Rentila automates those three, and produces the figures needed for the revenus fonciers declaration — which is the moment most landlords discover their record-keeping was incomplete.

Charge provision and annual regularisation
Tenant, property and document records

Reminder letters and arrears follow-up

Produce the figures needed for the annual revenus fonciers declaration

tools.name: Rent Manager
tools.positioning: The configurable one — for portfolios whose lease terms do not fit anybody's standard form.
tools.description: Rent Manager is a property management and accounting platform known for the depth of its configuration: user-defined fields, custom reports, a built-in contact centre, work order and asset tracking, and support for unusual property types including self-storage, marinas, manufactured housing and mixed portfolios.

A portfolio mixing apartments, commercial suites, storage units and ground leases has billing rules no template covers; Rent Manager lets an operator model them without leaving the accounting system. Tenants submit maintenance issues by video from the app, which cuts the diagnostic phone call, and payments can be split across cards, ACH or cash at retail locations.

tools.name: RentSpree
tools.positioning: Rental screening distributed through the MLS — the reason so many US agents handle rentals at all.
tools.description: RentSpree provides online rental applications, tenant screening reports from TransUnion, e-signature, rent payment and rent reporting. It is distributed through partnerships with MLSs and associations, which makes it the default rental workflow for a large share of US agents.

The applicant completes the application, pays the screening fee themselves, and authorises the credit, criminal and eviction report — so the agent never handles sensitive data or fronts a cost. For agents whose main business is sales, that low friction is why the rental side is worth doing at all.

TransUnion credit, criminal and eviction reports
Document collection with income verification
Lease e-signature and rent payment collection
MLS and association distribution partnerships
Agent referral and client management tools

Collect a complete, verified application file before deciding

tools.name: Smartloc
tools.positioning: Rental management for the private landlord with the applicant file verification built into the same flow.
tools.description: Smartloc offers French landlords an online rental management service: candidate application collection with document checking, lease generation and electronic signature, rent calls and receipts, payment tracking, and rent guarantee options.
tools.real_estate_use: Self-managing landlords make their worst decision at selection, not at management, and the document verification step is where a service earns its fee. Smartloc chains verification, lease signature and rent tracking so the landlord does not stitch together three tools around the moment the tenant is chosen.
features: Candidate application collection with document verification
Lease generation with the applicable French regime
Electronic signature on lease and annexes
Rent calls, receipts and payment tracking
Arrears follow-up and reminder letters
Rent guarantee options

use_cases.job: Verify an applicant's documents before signing rather than after a default
Run selection, signature and rent tracking without assembling three tools

tools.name: SmartRent
tools.positioning: Smart apartment hardware and software sold to the operator, not to the resident.
tools.description: SmartRent provides smart home hardware and a management platform for rental housing: smart locks, thermostats, leak sensors, self-guided tour access, community access control and parking, managed centrally by the operator across a portfolio.
tools.real_estate_use: Three operational cases drive the purchase. Self-guided tours let a prospect visit a vacant unit without staff. Smart locks remove the key handover and the lock change at turnover. Leak sensors catch water damage — the largest avoidable insurance claim in multifamily — before it reaches the unit below.
features: Smart locks with credential management at turnover
Self-guided tour access for prospective residents
Thermostat control on vacant units
Leak detection and water shut-off alerting
Community access control and parking management
Portfolio-wide device management and alerts

use_cases.job: Offer self-guided tours of vacant units without on-site staff
Reduce water damage claims and turnover costs across a portfolio

tools.name: Startloc
tools.positioning: État des lieux software priced for the individual landlord, not just the agency.
tools.description: Startloc is a French application for producing entry and exit état des lieux on phone or tablet: guided room-by-room capture, photographs, electronic signature by both parties and PDF report generation, sold at a per-inspection or subscription price accessible to individuals.
tools.real_estate_use: The private landlord doing their own inspection is exactly the person most exposed at exit, because their entry document is usually thin. A guided capture forces completeness — every room, every element, dated photographs — and the signed PDF is what the deposit deduction will rest on if the tenant contests it.
features: Guided room-by-room inspection capture
Photographic evidence attached to each element
Electronic signature by landlord and tenant on site
Entry-to-exit comparison
PDF report generation and storage
Meter reading and key handover recording

use_cases.job: Produce a complete entry inspection that supports a later deposit deduction
Run inspections on a phone without buying an agency-grade platform

tools.name: TenantCloud
tools.positioning: One account, three roles — landlord, tenant and service professional all get their own workspace.
tools.description: TenantCloud is a cloud platform with distinct portals for landlords, tenants and service professionals. Landlords get listings, applications, screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance and accounting; tenants get payments and requests; vendors get job assignments.
tools.real_estate_use: The tenant-side and vendor-side accounts are the point of difference: a tenant keeps their rental history and payment record across landlords, and a plumber receives assignments through the same system that generated the work order. For a small landlord it removes the email and text back-and-forth around every repair.
features: Separate landlord, tenant and service professional portals
Listings, applications and screening
Rent collection with automated invoicing and late fees
Maintenance requests routed to assigned vendors
Accounting with reports and tax preparation exports
Lease templates with e-signature

Keep rental payment history that follows you to the next landlord

tools.name: TurboTenant
tools.positioning: Free for the landlord, paid by the applicant — the model that put full rental tooling in the hands of people with three doors.
tools.description: TurboTenant offers listing syndication, online rental applications, tenant screening, state-specific lease agreements, e-signature, rent collection and expense tracking, with a free core tier funded largely by applicant-paid screening fees and premium add-ons.
tools.real_estate_use: The independent landlord's problem is not scale, it is competence: writing a compliant lease, running a legitimate credit and background check, and documenting rent payment for tax time. TurboTenant packages exactly those steps, which is why a very large number of small US landlords never buy property management software at all.
features: Listing syndication to major rental sites
Online applications with applicant-paid screening
State-specific lease agreements with e-signature
Online rent collection with automatic reminders
Expense and income tracking for tax reporting
Maintenance request intake from tenants

use_cases.job: Advertise, screen, lease and collect rent on a handful of units at almost no cost
Produce a compliant state-specific lease without a lawyer for each renewal

tools.name: Vilogi
tools.positioning: Condominium management software built for the French 1965 law, from the annual assembly to the works fund.
tools.description: Vilogi is a SaaS platform for French syndics and rental managers: per-building accounting, budgets and calls for funds, general assembly preparation and electronic voting, works and contract tracking, and extranet portals for co-owners and council members.
tools.real_estate_use: A French copropriété is a legal entity with its own accounts, its own budget voted in assembly, and a mandatory extranet for co-owners. Vilogi encodes that cycle: the provisional budget is voted, quarterly calls for funds are issued against it, expenses are posted per building, and the annual accounts are presented back to the assembly. The extranet obligation is met by the same system.
features: Per-building accounting with tantième-based expense allocation
Provisional budgets and quarterly calls for funds
General assembly preparation, convocation and electronic voting
Mandatory co-owner extranet with document access
Works, contract and insurance claim tracking
Rental management module for mixed portfolios

use_cases.job: Run the full annual cycle from voted budget to accounts presented at assembly
Meet the legal co-owner extranet obligation without a separate portal

tools.name: Yardi Breeze
tools.positioning: Yardi's accounting rigour, stripped of the implementation project that Voyager requires.
tools.description: Yardi Breeze and Breeze Premier are the self-service tier of Yardi's platform, aimed at small and mid-sized managers across residential, commercial, affordable and self-storage portfolios. tools.real_estate_use: Chosen by managers who want Yardi's accounting model — property-level ledgers, owner draws, CAM reconciliation in the Premier tier — without a six-month Voyager implementation. It is also the natural landing point for firms that expect to grow into Voyager later and want the data model to be familiar.
features: Property accounting with owner payments and reporting
Online applications, leases and rent collection
Maintenance requests and vendor work orders

Resident and owner portals

tools.name: Yardi Voyager
tools.positioning: The institutional system of record — where the lease, the ledger and the investor report are the same data.
tools.description: Voyager is Yardi's enterprise platform, deployed across commercial, multifamily, affordable, senior and student portfolios worldwide. It combines property accounting, lease administration, budgeting and forecasting, investment management and a large ecosystem of add-on modules, with localisations including France.
tools.real_estate_use: For an institutional owner, the question is not features but audit chain: the rent invoiced to a tenant, the indexation clause applied, the accrual booked and the figure reported to the fund's investors must all descend from one record. Voyager is bought for that continuity, and implementations run in months because the configuration encodes a firm's entire operating model.
features: Commercial and residential lease administration with clause handling
Property, corporate and investment accounting with multi-currency
Budgeting, forecasting and valuation workflows
Investment management and investor reporting
Maintenance, procurement and energy modules
Country localisations including French accounting and VAT treatment
